title: Alhambra guided tour
text: Cristina was an excellent guide from Live Granada. Shame the weather wasn't so kind to us!
author: G4420UHkirstyg

title: Excellent tour of the Alhambra
text: Lucked out with a tour of only 7 people at the Alhambra.  The tour guide was totally fluent in English and the cost of the tour was better than most which made the three hour tour fly quickly.  I have been to the Alhambra over 20  times and always take two to three tours each visit.  Each time I find that I learn sometime new with each guide and this was no exception.  A+  Our guide was full of facts but at the same time he was very open to questions.
author: 631arthurd

title: Wonderful experience at the Alhambra. Learned so much history, architecture, religious aspects and art.
text: Thank you so much Ana, from Live Granada, for organizing our informative and wonderful Alhambra tour. It was amazing. We met Laura, our tour guide, at 8:15 am and had an incredible experience at the Alhambra with her. Her passion for history, her understanding of the time period, the architecture, the religion and the individual leaders and families were amazing.  She explained in detail the culture, the history, so many details of the palaces and their inhabitants… we learned so much. author: Kathleen M
